title: Medium or demi-bold typeface stroke widths for low-vision legibility
statement:
For individuals with low vision, using typefaces with medium or demi-bold stroke widths significantly improves legibility compared to regular or light/thin sans-serif fonts.

Options:
- Optimal Low Vision Body: Medium or Demi-Bold weights (500-600) (fits: accessibility first design, medical portals)
- Standard Vision Default: Regular weights (400) (fits: general audience web, dense dashboards)
- Emphasis & Headings: Bold weights (700) (fits: alerts, marketing callouts)
- Aesthetic Display (Avoid): Light/Thin weights (100-300) (fits: fashion branding, large hero text only)
appliesWhen: Applies to: web, mobile, assistive tech. Audience: seniors, general.

source.title: The legibility of typefaces for readers with low vision: A research review
source.authors: K. Russell-Minda; J.W. Jutai; J.G. Strong; K.A. Bradley; P.E. Goddard; L. Yule; W.H. Hicks
